messages:
emily-sales: Heads up — RFP from Lynx (large fintech). They need: private VPC deployment, HSM/KMS, per-tenant throughput SLAs, and gateway integration. Questionnaire + network diagrams here: https://drive.company/lynx-rfp.pdf
raj-eng: Thanks. Do they want dedicated GPU pools or are shared-hosted ok for POC?
emily-sales: They asked for Dedicated for pilot; will consider Hosted for dev. POC timeline tight (3 weeks).
vika-security: On HSM/KMS: we can support customer-managed KMS for Private. For HSM-backed keys we need legal + infra review — estimate 5 business days.
alexa-solution: I can own the POC ops. Need a capability matrix row for: isolated tenancy, KMS/HSM, private control plane, VPC peering, audit logs retention, SOC2/FedRAMP notes.
mike-product: Also call out integration patterns with API gateways (mTLS vs prod LB). For throughput SLAs, what numbers are they asking?
emily-sales: They wrote: "SLO: 95th pctl p99 < 250ms for 8k qps across pooled models" — that's probably a misread. Exact quote: "sustained 8,000 qps across 12 endpoints with p99 latency budget 250ms".
raj-eng: Wow. 8k qps sustained with p99 250ms is only realistic with autoscale across many GPUs + batching. For Dedicated we can propose burst pools + soft fallback to cheaper model variants.
alexa-solution: I'll draft a performance plan. Quick ask: can we provide a sample rate-limit / throttling config for them to test with?
jordan-cs: Also include operational KPIs they asked for: error budget, MTTR, deployment cadence, and rollback policy.
emily-sales: They want our pricing bands for Dedicated (monthly commit + overage) and an estimated POC quote for a 3-week pilot. Include line items: infra, engineering support, extended logs retention.
raj-eng: For the RFP writeup, propose: baseline Dedicated cluster (8x A100-equivalent), autoscale policy to add 4x every 500 qps, intelligent batching with max_batch_size=128 and latency hint 150ms. Example config snippet:
```json
{
  "autoscale": {"scale_unit_qps": 500, "add_units": 4},
  "batching": {"max_batch_size": 128, "latency_target_ms": 150}
}
```
vika-security: For the security questionnaire: list out encryption in transit (mTLS), encryption at rest (AES-256), customer-managed keys support, HSM note (requires ent contract). Also call out audit log retention options (30/90/365 days) and SIEM hooks (syslog, S3 push).
dev-bot: Attached: capability-matrix-lynx-v1.csv (https://files.company/cap-matrix/2060456789.csv) :file_folder:
emily-sales: Great. Can someone assemble a one-page RFP answer doc + CSV matrix + a POC SOW draft by EOD tomorrow?
alexa-solution: I can do SOW + POC checklist. Will need one SME timebox from raj and vika for technical & security signoff (2hrs).
raj-eng: I can do the SME review Thursday 10am PT.
vika-security: I can do the security review Thursday 11am PT.
mike-product: I'll review the SLA wording and pricing bands after SOW draft.
jordan-cs: I'll prep the onboarding checklist for their engineers (peering steps, cert exchange, sample curl).
emily-sales: Cool. Action items: Alexa = SOW + matrix merge; Raj/Vika = SME reviews; Mike = pricing check; Jordan = onboarding doc. I'll reply to the buyer with "we can meet timeline, prepping POC SOW and security answers — will return full packet by Fri EOD". :thumbsup:
alexa-solution: Putting links in one place now — POC template, security FAQ, pricing sheet: https://drive.company/sales/presales-packages/
emily-sales: Thanks all. If Lynx pushes FedRAMP questions escalate to legal. I'll share the RFP PDF and their network diagram in the thread for context.
emily-sales: (uploaded lynx-network-diagram.png)
dev-bot: Note: thread pinned to #sales for tracking.
